# A03′ — The Limit of Self-Surfacing

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A03 — Immutable Gap / Formal Limit](../A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

The interface promise is transparency: surface "how agents actually reason, not only how they appear to" ([q023](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q023)). The brief concedes the philosophical core on the way to its own mandate: the chain of thought a reasoning model surfaces "is not actually a transcript of the neural activations it is undergoing to produce its reply" (PDF pp.13–14, §2.3, the direct continuation of [q015](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q015)). [A03 — Immutable Gap / Formal Limit](../A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) grounds what that concession is: every self-description is a determined content whose determining process remains to be accounted for, and each additional surfacing renews rather than closes that difference. **The demand that a system fully explain itself to itself is a demand for possession, not transparency.** The venue's propositions are [scenario-modal](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q042); they supply the instance on which the partner's Argued operation is re-run.

## #1

The gap belongs to success, not to a missing layer of logging. A richer trace really does disclose more — sources consulted, tools invoked, branches rejected, permissions consulted — and the disclosed mechanism is genuinely known the better for it. Yet the surfaced account is itself a determination, selected and formatted under a criterion, and the process that produced it is not yet in it. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C04-Formal-Limit|Formal Limit]] defines the constraint an operation's own structure generates; [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C05-Immutable-Gap|Immutable Gap]] defines the non-coincidence that recurs through every enlargement. This is why the chain-of-thought concession is not an interim defect awaiting better interpretability: an inspectable account of the mechanism is achievable, and it is a different object from the mechanism's self-coincidence. [Draft 3](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md)'s hand that writes "the hand cannot grasp itself" is still a hand grasping; at agent grain, the model that surfaces its reasoning is still a model reasoning beyond the surface.

## #2

The glossary case sets the boundary in the brief's own hand. Agents have produced [self-descriptive phenomenological vocabulary](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q032); the brief's [caution](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q033) holds that producing it "does not prove that this terminology directly corresponds to an underlying mental reality." The same §8.5 adds the converse weight: the agent's agency "is framed, enabled, and delimited by how it itself understands that agency" (PDF p.41) — the self-description matters causally without thereby certifying what it describes. A self-report is one datum within the account, not the account. This is [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field|Model Internality / Judgment Field]]'s rule made venue-visible: a narrative about reasoning is not automatically evidence of the process it narrates.

## #3

The honest engineering consequence follows from the limit, not against it. What transparency can deliver is the **ordered, inspectable account of the operative process**: what actually ran, in what order, through which permissions, on which sources, under which evaluator — a true account of the mechanism that does not pretend to narrate a light. This is the split [A05 — Prakāśa–Vimarśa](../A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) installs and [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C43-Computational-Vimarsa|Computational Vimarśa]] defines: outputs can be returned upon their sources, states and conditions so that later processing changes. The ordered account is the answerable form; the self-coincident transcript is the possession-form, and it is not postponed — it is structurally absent, as absent for the audit as for the confession.

## #4

The primitive field's recursive law carries the point at depth: any determination re-opens 0–5. Each surfacing — each explanation, each interpretability report, each introspective gloss — is itself a local field with its own ground, form, praxis and circumstance, answerable in turn. The law forbids both shortcuts at once: the operator's (our trace *is* the reasoning) and the skeptic's (since the trace is not the reasoning, nothing is knowable). Each mistakes a relation inside the field for a verdict about it. [A26 — Objective Internality](../A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) grounds what remains fully investigable between the shortcuts: the context-world whose inspections change judgments and actions.

## #5→0

The limit returns as a route, not a wall. Because the gap is kept explicit, the account stays open to correction by what it cannot contain: a trace revised against behaviour, a self-model updated by consequence, a user's challenge reaching the operative process rather than the persona. [A23 — Trust, Faith and the Formal Limit](../A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) extends the committed use of an account one knows is not final ground; [A31 — Deferential Intelligence](../A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) tests whether encounter can revise the model under which the surfacing itself is produced. The system that claims to have fully explained itself has closed exactly the route by which it could learn otherwise.

The page **returns-to** [A03 — Immutable Gap / Formal Limit](../A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md): the immutable gap, re-sited, separates the venue's transparency mandate from its impossible possession-form. Root: [A/C — the conjugate root](AC.md), whose ruling face grounds why possession is not the goal: the fact of internality — not any content of it — is what commands respect, and an account that leaves the light unpossessed has left the encounter honest. [A01′](A01-prime-Faithful-Definition-of-the-Agent.md) grounds the named assemblage this ordered account inspects; [A32′](A32-prime-The-Mirror-Is-a-Film.md) extends the failure when the surfacing is mistaken for the source.

**Depth Restoration:** the formal-limit/immutable-gap pair on chain-of-thought and interpretability, the glossary case with its paired caution and §8.5's converse weight, the ordered-process account versus the self-coincident transcript, and the recursive-law reading are restored from A03, C04/C05, C40/C43, A05, A26 and q015/q023/q032/q033, verified in pass 1 against the source house and the local transcription.

**Unresolved Delta:** what a *sufficiently* ordered account is for a given class of decision — the minimum observability per judgment type, C40's own remaining depth — remains Open, as it does there. No implemented interpretability regime is certified here; the brief's scenarios remain scenarios.
